findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_jet_estimate · Private data: get_jet_estimate, request_jet_confirmation, get_confirmation_status, search_empty_legs, lookup_airports, list_attributed_enquiries · Public sink: get_jet_estimate, request_jet_confirmation, get_confirmation_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_jet_estimate · Private data: get_jet_estimate, request_jet_confirmation, get_confirmation_status, search_empty_legs, lookup_airports, list_attributed_enquiries · Public sink: get_jet_estimate, request_jet_confirmation, get_confirmation_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
